summary: Lantronix Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a Sales Agreement with Needham & Co. and Canaccord Genuity for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $30 million of its common stock. Sales will be made under Rule 415 via Nasdaq at prevailing market prices with a 3% commission to the designated agent. This is a routine at-the-market shelf takedown, not a special situation, as it involves ordinary equity distribution without a fixed price, premium, or structural complexity beyond standard ATM mechanics. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, or other transformative event. The filing merely establishes sales agency terms for future at-the-market issuances.
